openesc-die-temp-ramp.title: Die temperature in a ramp
openesc-die-temp-ramp.finding: The die reading rose from 23 C to 156 C as the clamp current climbed to 39.8 A, and peaked at 161 C.

openesc-shunt-vs-clamp.title: Current sense against clamp
openesc-shunt-vs-clamp.finding: At 80 percent throttle the sense reading was 11.6 A against 32.4 A on the clamp; at 100 percent, 64.7 A against 55.7 A.

openfc-lite-flight-die-temp.title: ESC die temperature in flight
openfc-lite-flight-die-temp.finding: The 8 inch peaked at 87.4 C on 6S and 116 C on 8S; the 5 inch flights at 52.6 C and 64.0 C.

openmotor-hold-esc-temp.title: ESC temperature per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-esc-temp.finding: Channel 1 die temperature rises from 44 C at 10 percent throttle to 72 C at 100 percent in the 13:25 UTC run.

openmotor-hold-pack-voltage.title: Pack voltage per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-pack-voltage.finding: In the 13:25 UTC run the pack sags from 24.4 V at 10 percent throttle to 19.3 V at 100 percent.

openmotor-hold-rpm.title: Rotor speed per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-rpm.finding: Rotor speed rises from about 5000 rpm at 10 percent throttle to 29350 rpm at 100 percent, in the 13:25 UTC run.
openmotor-hold-rpm.chip: Same OpenMotor-2306, two 6S packs, cell calibrated to 1726 g, ESC reversed

openmotor-hold-thrust.title: Thrust per throttle hold
openmotor-hold-thrust.finding: Thrust is 30 g at 10 percent throttle and 1496 g at 100 percent, in the 13:25 UTC run.

log.tested: Thrust map on the new thrust stand: ten throttle holds from 10 to 100 percent.
log.saw: In the 13:25 UTC run thrust reached 1496 g at 100 percent throttle on the OpenMotor-2306. In the earlier 13:16 UTC run pack voltage read 0 V from the 80 percent step, cause not recorded, and the throttle profile kept stepping up to full.
log.changed: The bench controller now aborts the run when the pack is pulled, and the 13:25 UTC run was recorded with that change. The thrust stand test plans no longer include a current cut, because current sense on the stand is not calibrated.

log.tested: Continuous current rating by stepping to a fixed current and waiting for the die temperature to settle.
log.saw: Calculated from the fitted thermal time constant of 5 to 10 minutes, not captured: a fixed-current step on a pack cannot reach thermal steady state, because 20 s at the target current gives only a few percent of the steady temperature rise.
log.changed: The bench now holds a target die temperature and reads the current needed to hold it.

log.tested: Review of the scope captures from the destructive ramp session.
log.saw: Scope channel 1 read one constant value in all nine sessions of that afternoon and no check flagged it.

log.tested: Throttle sweep against a clamp reference.
log.saw: The current-sense amplifier reading, as read by the bench controller, did not track the clamp: 11.6 A against 32.4 A at 80 percent throttle, and 64.7 A against 55.7 A at 100 percent.
log.changed: An input network was added to the current-sense amplifier in rev3.2. It has not been tested on hardware: no capture after the change exists.

log.tested: One channel ramped from 0 to full throttle with no thermal guard.
log.saw: Clamp current peaked at 39.8 A with the die sensor at 156 C. The die reading reached 161 C and bus voltage telemetry then stopped.

log.tested: First flights of the full stack on five drones.
log.saw: 103 blackbox logs from four of the drones, about half of them arm and disarm blips. The fifth drone's SD card failed after the session. On the 8 inch, seven logs were recorded with the FC on a separate battery, so their voltage is not pack voltage.

log.tested: Ride out to 5.3 km with a Gemini and a Mono on the same carry.
log.saw: Beyond 2.9 km the Gemini's reported RSSI was below the Mono's in 24 of the 25 100 m bins and equal in one, by a median of 4 dB and up to 7 dB. Its link quality was higher in all 25 bins, by a median of 15 points. The log numbers its receivers instead of naming them, so the column-to-unit mapping was taken from the operators' notes and one duplicate column was excluded.
